spiritual_reading:
Attend to the first directed influx that proceeded from the Divine Life at the beginning. The Divine sent it into the good that first engages directly with evil. It was an impartation of concord and conjunction, flowing from love into the will as a salutation of unity to what was akin within the same order; and within that influx was contained, in full comprehensiveness, the whole disclosure of what was to be brought into effect, together with the entire arrangement of the uses it would establish through that influx. By that influx, the first good was set into its appointed course, and the whole process that must follow from it was determined.

In return, the responsive perception proceeding from that first good ascended into a more interior and elevated awareness, and so came back to the Divine Life. This, too, was a reciprocal communication, flowing from the engaged good back toward its source, and within it was comprehended the full disclosure of the state: every assault, every conflict, and every temptation that had been endured in opposing what was contrary. It carried the whole series in order—everything that had taken place in act, everything that was to take place in continuation, what had already been effected, and what was now disposed and prepared to be effected through that same good. Therefore the Divine Life, from its own omniscience and immediate presence, perceived completely all the oppositions, perils, and contests that the governing falsities had raised against that first good.

fills.notes: The answer-letter contains “tidings” and an ordered series of conflicts. The spiritual sense requires that it be comprehensive and sufficient, not a partial notice; thus a turn like “not only report” prepares for the following clause that it contained the whole account.

The clause needs a verbal act that gathers “everything that had happened” into the return-communication. In the substrate register, the answer is an impersonal conveyance of the full state; “was recounting” fits the correspondential requirement of a complete ordered disclosure of events and of what is prepared.
The spiritual translation explicitly includes future continuation in the answer’s contents; this editor fill matches the required series: past in act and future in continuation.

assessment: Most of the recovery is constrained by the correspondential structure: the return-letter must comprehensively disclose the whole series (past and future) of conflicts and preparations. Exact idiom for the two verbal gaps remains somewhat open, but the required function is tight: an explicit statement of completeness and an act of ordered recounting.
